name: print-social-purple-grow-your-business-ad-with-jumping-man
title: Purple 'Great Ideas to Grow Your Business!' ad with a jumping man holding a laptop
whatItIs: A square violet ad with a cut-out man mid-leap holding a laptop in front of a yellow circle, a chunky white and yellow headline, a numbered services list with a vertical 'What we do' label, curved hand-drawn arrows and a yellow 'Contact us' pill.
whatItMeans: Energetic and fun; the jump sells momentum and optimism.
techniques: Use a mid-air pose for energy.
Put a bright circle behind the cut-out.
Rotate a section label vertically beside its list.
Draw curvy arrows to guide the eye to CTAs.

vocabulary.definition: A dynamic photo pose like jumping.
